description.value: The Red Accordion is a farm-to-table restaurant and pub housed in a converted red house on the corner of Alberni and Cardero Streets, tucked between Vancouver's West End and Coal Harbour. The menu spans brunch through dinner with dishes like lobster eggs benedict and shakshuka alongside an extensive lineup of BC craft beers, local wines, and classic cocktails. The venue also hosts live music and featured artists, giving it a neighbourhood living-room character amid downtown high-rises.
